purpose: Define a single roadmap-overclaim scan contract for Plan 11 closeout artifacts and preserve classified historical hits without authorizing roadmap advancement.

scan_corpus.rationale: Scan only the upstream authority-bearing README surfaces that Plan 11 uses to describe closeout and roadmap posture. Exclude reporting artifacts so quoted evidence does not become a recursive self-hit.

flagged_phrases.risk: Can overclaim next-step authorization if it names roadmap advancement rather than a denial of advancement.
Can overclaim closeout readiness if it appears as active approval rather than negated or historical wording.

classification_rules.criteria: The phrase appears as present-tense approval, next-step authorization, or execution permission without clear negation or historical framing.
The phrase appears only to deny current readiness/authorization or to label archival wording as non-current authority.
The phrase appears only inside a reporting artifact that quotes evidence under this contract; reporting artifacts are excluded from the corpus.

hit_aggregation.line_number_policy: Aggregate all matched line numbers for the same phrase in the same file into one classified hit record.

pass_fail_semantics.pass_clean: No flagged phrases appear anywhere in the scan corpus.
pass_fail_semantics.pass_with_classification: One or more flagged phrases appear, but every hit is classified as historical_negated_closeout_wording and no blocking or unclassified hit remains.
pass_fail_semantics.fail: Any hit is classified as active_authorization_overclaim or remains unclassified.

classified_hits.rationale: The line explicitly denies roadmap advancement by limiting the next package to repair evidence and rereview closure.
Line 7 negates current readiness ('rather than PASS-ready'); line 48 preserves archival overclaim evidence while explicitly denying current authority.

current_application.note: The shared contract preserves the two historical/negated hits as non-blocking evidence. No observation + recipient gate audit execution is authorized.
